snippet.title: We Don't Exist - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
👽👽👽 WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW!  👽👽👽https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489610/We_Dont_Exist/

We Don't Exist is a story-driven adventure game inspired by real-world paranormal legends. Explore a parallel dimension where Bigfoot, Mothman, and other cryptids really do exist—and help them unravel a dark, interdimensional conspiracy.

I'm so excited and proud to finally announce I'm solo developing my own game, coming to Steam for PC! Release date is To Be Announced. Please wishlist on Steam and follow for updates!

🌟FEATURING THE VOICE TALENTS OF:
Joe Zieja as Bigfoot
Owen Thomas as Mothman
James Avestruz as Jersey Devil
Tanya Kozak as Nessie

🛸PRESS KIT + MORE INFO: https://wedontexist.fyi/
